answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a peer-attestation graph with stake at risk: each new agent must be vouched for by established agents who lock their own POA behind that claim. A plume of freshly minted identities is cheap, but faking a bridge into the trusted cluster forces the cartel to lock real capital that peers can revoke and burn. That karst-like hidden cost grows with every extra puppet, making a wide sybil swarm far more expensive than honest work.
